description: Check which Bedrock text models work on this AWS account right now. Sends one small billed call (a one-word prompt, at most 32 output tokens) to each model: every registry text model (35) by default, or only the models passed. Returns a table with one status per model: ok (answered), throttled (rate or quota limit right now; try again later), denied (no model access or not authorized on this account), invalid (unknown model id, not in the registry, or not offered in this region), error (anything else; see the note).

concurrency.description: Models checked at the same time, 1-8 (default 4)

models.description: Model aliases or IDs to check (default every text model in the registry); a repeated model is checked once

name: bedrock_doctor
